title: Constraint satisfaction instance
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, let a finite family of predicates on $D$ be specified with an arity and a Boolean evaluation rule for each predicate, and let $V$ be a set of variables. A constraint instance consists of a nonempty multiset of constraints, each applying one of the specified predicates to an ordered tuple of distinct variables, such that every variable in $V$ occurs in the scope of at least one constraint.
hypotheses_covered: A specified finite family of predicates on the domain
Each predicate has an arity and Boolean evaluation rule
The constraints form a nonempty multiset
Each constraint has a predicate and an ordered tuple of distinct variables of the required arity
Every declared variable occurs in at least one constraint scope
